verdict.rationale: Deploying a server-rendered app to serverless or edge runtimes is a fair question for a web framework like Angular, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions server-side rendering, serverless, or edge adapters. The only related item is the generic 'ng deploy' command, which invokes a configurable deploy builder; that is an adjacent building block, not documented SSR deployment to serverless or edge runtimes.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my server-rendered app to serverless or edge runtimes without custom infrastructure setup
